info.title: Qatar Open Data
info.description: Qatar Open Data is the national open data portal of the State of Qatar, published by the National Planning Council. This connector searches the dataset catalogue, reads and filters records, enumerates facets, lists attachments, and exports catalogue or dataset content as files.

get.description: Returns the datasets published on the Qatar Open Data portal, with their metadata and field schema. Use the Filter, Refine and Order By options to narrow and sort the catalogue.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: An ODSQL where expression used to filter the results. It supports full-text search, logical operators such as AND, OR and NOT, and comparison functions. Example: year > 2020 AND nationality like 'Qatari'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items to return. Use together with Offset to page through results. The maximum value is 100 for a query without a group by expression and 20000 for a query with one. Use an export operation to retrieve larger volumes of data.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The index of the first item to return, starting at 0. Use together with Limit to page through results. Offset plus Limit must remain below 10000 for a query without a group by expression.

parameters.name: refine
parameters.description: A facet filter that restricts the results to a single facet value, using the syntax facet_name:facet_value. Example: theme:Health.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: A facet filter that removes a facet value from the results, using the syntax facet_name:facet_value. Example: theme:Health.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: An ODSQL select expression that controls which fields are returned. Use a field name to return a single field, a wildcard to return every field, or an expression with an 'as' label to return a calculated field. Example: dataset_id, fields.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of field names or aggregations to sort on, each optionally followed by asc or desc. Results are sorted in ascending order by default. Example: modified desc.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: An ODSQL group by expression that aggregates the results by a field, a range function or a date function. A custom name can be set with the 'as' notation. Example: year as reporting_year.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: The language used to format strings such as dates in the response. Qatar Open Data publishes metadata in English (en) and Arabic (ar).

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: The timezone applied to date and datetime fields, given as a Unicode CLDR timezone identifier such as UTC or Asia/Qatar.

parameters.name: include_links
parameters.description: Set to true to add HATEOAS navigation links to the response.

parameters.name: include_app_metas
parameters.description: Set to true to add application metadata to the response.

200.description: The list of datasets matching the query.

400.description: The request is malformed, usually because an ODSQL expression is invalid.

429.description: The request was rejected because the call quota of the portal has been exceeded.

500.description: The Qatar Open Data portal encountered an internal error.

parameters.description: An ODSQL where expression used to filter the results. It supports full-text search, logical operators such as AND, OR and NOT, and comparison functions. Example: year > 2020 AND nationality like 'Qatari'.

parameters.name: refine
parameters.description: A facet filter that restricts the results to a single facet value, using the syntax facet_name:facet_value. Example: theme:Health.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: A facet filter that removes a facet value from the results, using the syntax facet_name:facet_value. Example: theme:Health.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: The timezone applied to date and datetime fields, given as a Unicode CLDR timezone identifier such as UTC or Asia/Qatar.

200.description: The facet values available across the catalogue.

400.description: The request is malformed, usually because an ODSQL expression is invalid.

429.description: The request was rejected because the call quota of the portal has been exceeded.

500.description: The Qatar Open Data portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Exports the dataset catalogue as a file in the requested format, for example CSV, XLSX or DCAT. The export is not subject to the record limit that applies to list operations.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The file format of the export. Available formats for the catalogue are listed by the corresponding list export formats operation.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: An ODSQL where expression used to filter the results. It supports full-text search, logical operators such as AND, OR and NOT, and comparison functions. Example: year > 2020 AND nationality like 'Qatari'.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: An ODSQL select expression that controls which fields are returned. Use a field name to return a single field, a wildcard to return every field, or an expression with an 'as' label to return a calculated field. Example: dataset_id, fields.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of field names or aggregations to sort on, each optionally followed by asc or desc. Results are sorted in ascending order by default. Example: modified desc.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: An ODSQL group by expression that aggregates the results by a field, a range function or a date function. A custom name can be set with the 'as' notation. Example: year as reporting_year.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items to include in the export. Use -1 to export every item. The export operations are not subject to the record limit that applies to the list operations.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The index of the first item to return, starting at 0. Use together with Limit to page through results. Offset plus Limit must remain below 10000 for a query without a group by expression.

parameters.name: refine
parameters.description: A facet filter that restricts the results to a single facet value, using the syntax facet_name:facet_value. Example: theme:Health.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: A facet filter that removes a facet value from the results, using the syntax facet_name:facet_value. Example: theme:Health.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: The language used to format strings such as dates in the response. Qatar Open Data publishes metadata in English (en) and Arabic (ar).

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: The timezone applied to date and datetime fields, given as a Unicode CLDR timezone identifier such as UTC or Asia/Qatar.

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: The character used to separate fields. This option applies to the CSV format only.

parameters.name: list_separator
parameters.description: The character used to separate the values of a multivalued field. This option applies to the CSV format only.

parameters.name: quote_all
parameters.description: Set to true to surround every string value with quote characters. This option applies to the CSV format only.

parameters.name: with_bom
parameters.description: Set to true to begin the file with a Unicode byte order mark, which helps Microsoft Excel open the file with the correct encoding. This option applies to the CSV format only.

get.description: Returns a single record from a dataset by its record identifier. Record identifiers are returned by the List records operation when recordid is passed in the Select Fields option.

parameters.description: The identifier of the dataset to query. It appears in the Information tab of the dataset page and in the dataset URL, immediately after /datasets/.

parameters.name: record_id

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: An ODSQL select expression that controls which fields are returned. Use a field name to return a single field, a wildcard to return every field, or an expression with an 'as' label to return a calculated field. Example: dataset_id, fields.

Link.description: A navigation link returned by the portal.

rel.description: The relationship of the link to the current resource, for example self, next, last, dataset or an export format name.

href.description: The absolute URL of the linked resource.

LinkResults.description: A response that contains navigation links only.

links.description: The available links, one per related resource or export format.

DatasetField.description: A field in the schema of a dataset.

name.description: The technical name of the field, used in ODSQL expressions.

label.description: The display label of the field.

label_en.description: The English display label of the field.

label_ar.description: The Arabic display label of the field.

type.description: The data type of the field, for example text, double, date or geo_point_2d.

description.description: The description of the field, when the publisher has supplied one.

description_en.description: The English description of the field, when the publisher has supplied one.

description_ar.description: The Arabic description of the field, when the publisher has supplied one.

annotations.description: Additional processing annotations applied to the field, such as the precision of a time series.

DatasetMetadata.description: The descriptive metadata of a dataset.

title_en.description: The English title of the dataset.

title_ar.description: The Arabic title of the dataset.

description.description: The description of the dataset, supplied as HTML.

description_en.description: The English description of the dataset, supplied as HTML.

description_ar.description: The Arabic description of the dataset, supplied as HTML.

publisher.description: The government body that publishes the dataset.

publisher_en.description: The English name of the government body that publishes the dataset.

publisher_ar.description: The Arabic name of the government body that publishes the dataset.

theme.description: The themes the dataset belongs to.

theme_en.description: The English names of the themes the dataset belongs to.

theme_ar.description: The Arabic names of the themes the dataset belongs to.

keyword.description: The keywords assigned to the dataset.

keyword_en.description: The English keywords assigned to the dataset.

keyword_ar.description: The Arabic keywords assigned to the dataset.

license.description: The licence the dataset is published under.

license_en.description: The English name of the licence the dataset is published under.

license_ar.description: The Arabic name of the licence the dataset is published under.

license_url.description: The URL of the licence text.

license_url_en.description: The URL of the English licence text.

license_url_ar.description: The URL of the Arabic licence text.

language.description: The primary language of the metadata.

metadata_languages.description: The languages the metadata is available in.

timezone.description: The timezone the date fields are expressed in.

modified.description: The date and time the dataset was last modified.

data_processed.description: The date and time the data was last processed.

metadata_processed.description: The date and time the metadata was last processed.

records_count.description: The number of records held in the dataset.

update_frequency.description: How often the dataset is updated, for example ANNUAL or MONTHLY.

geographic_reference.description: The geographic areas the dataset covers.

geometry_types.description: The geometric shape types held in the dataset, such as Point or MultiPolygon. It is empty for a dataset that holds no geographic data.

references.description: A reference URL supplied by the publisher.

attributions.description: The attributions requested by the publisher.

source_domain.description: The portal the dataset was federated from, when applicable.

federated.description: Indicates whether the dataset is federated from another portal.

DatasetAttachment.description: A file attached to a dataset, as listed in the dataset metadata.

url.description: The download URL of the attachment.

mimetype.description: The media type of the attachment.

Dataset.description: A dataset published on the Qatar Open Data portal.

dataset_id.description: The identifier of the dataset, used by every other operation.

dataset_uid.description: The immutable internal identifier of the dataset.

has_records.description: Indicates whether the dataset contains records.

data_visible.description: Indicates whether the data of the dataset is publicly visible.

visibility.description: The visibility level of the dataset on the portal.

features.description: The portal features enabled for the dataset, such as analyze or timeserie.

fields.description: The schema of the dataset, one entry per field.

attachments.description: The files attached to the dataset.

alternative_exports.description: The alternative export files published alongside the dataset.

_links.description: Navigation links, returned when the Include Links option is enabled.

DatasetMetadataContainer.description: The metadata templates applied to a dataset.

DatasetResults.description: A page of datasets returned by a catalogue query.

total_count.description: The total number of datasets matching the query.

results.description: The datasets returned for the current page.

_links.description: Navigation links, returned when the Include Links option is enabled.

Record.description: A single record of a dataset. The data fields of a record are defined by the schema of its dataset, so they differ from one dataset to another. Use the Get dataset operation to read the field names and types of a dataset.

_links.description: Navigation links, returned when the Include Links option is enabled.

RecordResults.description: A page of records returned by a dataset query.

total_count.description: The total number of records matching the query.

results.description: The records returned for the current page.

_links.description: Navigation links, returned when the Include Links option is enabled.

FacetValue.description: A single value of a facet.

name.description: The display name of the facet value.

value.description: The value to pass to the Refine or Exclude option.

count.description: The number of items that carry this facet value.

state.description: Whether the value is displayed, refined or excluded in the current query.

Facet.description: A facet and the values enumerated for it.

name.description: The name of the facet field.

facets.description: The values enumerated for this facet.

FacetResults.description: The facets enumerated for a catalogue or dataset query.

facets.description: The facets enumerated for the query.

links.description: Navigation links returned with the facets.

AttachmentMetadata.description: The metadata of an attached file.

url.description: The download URL of the attachment.

mime-type.description: The media type of the attachment.

Attachment.description: A file attached to a dataset.

href.description: The URL the attachment can be downloaded from.

AttachmentResults.description: The files attached to a dataset.

attachments.description: The files attached to the dataset.

links.description: Navigation links returned with the attachments.
